data.narrative:
Cognitive Space, a Seed-stage space and aerospace company founded by Guy de Carufel, has raised $10.3M to date. The broader Space & Aerospace sector includes five public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) trading at a median P/S multiple of 24.4x, alongside eight private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and ICEYE. However, narrow peer comparability is limited: only one same-stage private company exists in the addressable comp universe, precluding a reliable peer-median approach.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable triangulation approach. Using total capital raised ($10.3M) as a valuation proxy and applying a standard 2.5x multiplier for Seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $26M. This reflects typical venture step-up patterns absent company-specific financial data. Public comp anchoring cannot be applied; while the six-ticker Space & Aerospace median supports material valuations in this range, Cognitive Space's revenue remains undisclosed, making P/S calibration impossible.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $22M to $30M (median $26M), with the single-method foundation introducing material uncertainty. Key dependencies include: actual revenue or recurring customer traction (unmeasured), technology differentiation within a crowded orbital-services market, and path to next funding event. This valuation should be revised when revenue and unit economics become available.
